# FRAMEWORK-IMPROVEMENTS — suggestions for cap-evolve itself (cross-run)

NOT about this capability or this run's result — about what cap-evolve the FRAMEWORK should change so FUTURE runs (any capability, any project) go better: a confusing prompt section, a missing tool, a file you wished existed, a gate that felt wrong. Optional most iterations; add an entry whenever something about the framework itself (not the task) got in your way or surprised you.

## Iteration cand_0001
- A per-candidate offline "guard-fires" harness would help: I had to hand-write /tmp/verify_pax.py to prove the passenger repair reproduces gold on the failing task's exact args and doesn't fire on passing-shaped inputs. A framework-provided `validate --replay <task_id>` that runs a wrapper against a trajectory's recorded tool-call args (without scoring the whole episode) would let optimizers verify REAL/SAFE/VERIFIED cheaply and consistently, instead of everyone reinventing it.
- The COMMUNICATE reward is a comma-stripped substring check; it would help to state that contract explicitly in the capability guidance (it strongly favors enriching the RETURN with the exact literal string/number to say), since it changes which lever fixes a COMMUNICATE-basis failure vs a DB-basis one.
